title: JobSpec
description: The single structured contract that ties the three modules together. Built once by the Estimator (voice AND/OR documents), confirmed by the user, then reused VERBATIM by the Caller on every call and by the Closer during negotiation. A common envelope plus a vertical-specific `spec` whose fields are declared by the vertical config.

jobId.description: Stable id reused across all calls for this job.

vertical.description: Vertical key; must match a file in config/verticals/.

source.description: How the spec was produced. Both paths must yield this identical schema.

confirmedByUser.description: MUST be true before any call is made. The user confirms the spec verbatim.

location.description: City / region used to build the call list.

disclosureName.description: How the agent names itself and who it acts for, e.g. 'an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer'.

budget.description: The buyer's ZOPA — Zone Of Possible Agreement.

target.description: The price the buyer hopes to pay.

walkAway.description: The most the buyer will pay. Above this, decline.

neededBy.description: Hard deadline (e.g. wedding date, move date).

flexible.description: Timing flexibility is itself a negotiation lever.

spec.description: Vertical-specific requirements. Field shape is declared by the vertical config's `specFields`. This is the description the Caller repeats identically on every call.

alternatives.description: Acceptable substitutions the buyer will consider (partial specs). Lets the Caller widen the net without misrepresenting the job.

levers.description: Allowed negotiation levers for this job (subset of the vertical config's negotiationLevers).

belowMarketPct.description: A quote this far below the vertical benchmark is a warning, not a win.
